A friendly update this hopeful stint
Autumn is here

Pet travel made simple

As travel plans gather pace, the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways encourages every traveler to prepare early and keep pet documents within easy reach. Our team welcomes questions in a calm, practical manner, and a welfare coordinator reviews each animal's comfort needs before departure. <<FACT F034>> <<FACT F040>> Please bring familiar bedding, confirm carrier fit, and allow staff to guide you through boarding so the journey feels steady and reassuring for everyone.

This season, we invite travelers to check in with us before leaving for the skyport, especially when pets are adjusting to new routines. Clear labels, timely arrival, and patient handling help protect animal welfare from start to finish, and our trained staff will support each step with care. If you are planning to fly with a companion animal, please follow the desk's advice closely so your trip remains orderly, humane, and as stress-free as possible.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
